_meta.purpose: The 'Before you start' agreement every install accepts before a first scan (D-105). Change the text, change the version: everyone is asked again.
_meta.who: Wording by Claude from Sushil's direction (2026-09-26): correct data first; no AI-made pictures; a real person. 2026-10-08 (Sushil, D-182): a shopper's front photo may become the pack picture others see, after a person checks it; and example photos as a suggestion. 2026-10-08 (Sushil, D-184, version 2026-10-08-2): no invite codes, so a made-up picture no longer 'can close my invite'.

title: Before you start
intro: InsideLabel only works if every photo is of a real pack. Each one is checked, by our rules and often by a person, before it joins the catalogue. Please agree to these few rules.
points: I am a real person using InsideLabel myself, not an automated program.
I will only photograph real packs that I am holding or that are in front of me.
I will not upload pictures made or changed by AI, edited photos, or screenshots of websites and apps.
I understand that what I send may be checked by a person, and that made-up or altered pictures are removed.
I agree that a clear photo I take of the front of a pack may be shown to other InsideLabel users as that product's picture, after a person checks that it shows only the pack.
I understand that InsideLabel shows ingredient facts from the label. It is not medical advice.

examples.title: Photos that read best
examples.note: Flat, sharp, in good light, with the whole panel in the frame. This is a suggestion: any clear photo of the pack works.
